name: Old School Hash Co. Bubble Hash | Eastside OG
description: Solventless, pure, and bursting with flavor—our Bubble Hash is made from ice water–sieved resin for a smooth and terp-rich experience. Use it to top your bowl or roll it in a joint to spice up your next session. Packed in a reusable tin, perfect for keeping your stash fresh.
